results.title: Trump Won’t Reimburse Taxpayers: US President Declines To Repay Federal Funds Spent On Controversial Midterm Ads
results.description: US President Donald Trump has indicated that he will not reimburse the federal government for millions of taxpayer dollars already spent on controversial television advertisements promoting his administration ahead of the November midterm elections. The post Trump Won’t Reimburse Taxpayers: US President Declines To Repay Federal Funds Spent On Controversial Midterm Ads appeared first on The Sunday Guardian.
